summary: Rebuild the existing Portfolio repository as Polaris, a modern Astro + Tailwind static portfolio with Home, About, Work, Services, and Contact pages. The site will use Netlify Forms, be Netlify-deployment ready, preserve only verifiable project links and claims, and use an accessible, restrained dark Polaris visual system.

workspaceSignals.decisionReason: An existing static HTML, CSS, and vanilla JavaScript portfolio repository is present and the requested work is a rebuild of that repository.

questions.question: Which programming language for Polaris Portfolio?

options.label: TypeScript
options.description: Type-safe language for Astro components and client-side interactions

options.label: JavaScript
options.description: Plain JavaScript for Astro components and client-side interactions

questions.rationale: The brief specifies Astro but does not choose TypeScript or JavaScript; TypeScript is the recommended default for a modern Astro rebuild.

questions.question: Which framework and styling approach for Polaris Portfolio?

options.label: Astro + Tailwind CSS
options.description: Astro static site generation with Tailwind CSS utility styling

options.label: Astro + custom CSS
options.description: Astro static site generation with hand-authored CSS

questions.rationale: The approved brief explicitly requests a modern Astro + Tailwind static portfolio.

questions.question: Describe the pages, content, integrations, and constraints for Polaris Portfolio.
questions.recommendedChoice: Five static pages (Home, About, Work, Services, Contact); accessible services copy; restrained dark Polaris design; Netlify Forms contact flow; Netlify deployment readiness; only real, verifiable project links and claims; preserve or migrate verified existing portfolio content without inventing project details.
questions.answer: Five static pages (Home, About, Work, Services, Contact); accessible services copy; restrained dark Polaris design; Netlify Forms contact flow; Netlify deployment readiness; only real, verifiable project links and claims; preserve or migrate verified existing portfolio content without inventing project details.
questions.rationale: Distilled directly from the approved brief and the existing repository's verified portfolio context.

questions.question: Which data stores does your app need?

options.label: No datastore required
options.description: The static site does not persist application data or use storage, queues, or caches

questions.rationale: The brief requests a static portfolio and Netlify Forms, with no application database, object storage, queue, cache, or Azure Functions backend.

questions.question: Does this app need user login?

options.label: Yes
options.description: Add a user sign-in flow and authenticated API access

options.label: No
options.description: No user sign-in or authenticated API access

questions.rationale: This is a public portfolio with a public contact form and no signed-in user experience.
